app.name: The Conspiracy Atlas
app.tagline: An Interactive Global Archive of Theories, Mysteries & Connections.
app.notFoundText: This page does not exist in the archive.
app.freeOnly: Free-only infrastructure: no paid services are used.

statusHelp.historically_documented: Established by primary records such as official documents, court records or contemporaneous evidence.
statusHelp.supported_by_evidence: Backed by credible evidence, but not fully established.
statusHelp.partially_supported: Some elements are supported, others are not.
statusHelp.disputed: Credible sources disagree; the evidence is contested.
statusHelp.unverified: Claimed, but not supported by verifiable evidence.
statusHelp.under_investigation: Currently being reviewed by the editors.

home.lead: Explore theories, mysteries and documented secret operations on a giant investigation wall. Every claim is labelled with its evidence status and linked to its sources.
home.p1Text: Each entry lists its central claims individually, each with its own evidence status.
home.p2Text: Sources are linked to the specific claim they support or refute, never to a whole article by default.
home.p3Text: Anyone can submit a theory, with a display name or anonymously. Every submission is reviewed first.
home.sticky: Follow the sources, not the noise.

wall.title: Investigation Wall
wall.intro: Drag to move, scroll to zoom, double-click a card to focus. Red threads show how entries are connected.
wall.localNote: Views and your own card arrangement are stored only in this browser.
wall.connectHint: Select two cards (click, then Shift+click) to draw a thread.
wall.stressTest: Synthetic performance test data ({count} cards) – not saved.

archive.title: Theory Archive
archive.intro: Every case file separates historical facts from further claims and links each claim to its sources.

theory.claimHint: Each claim has its own evidence status. A source only counts for the claim it is attached to.
theory.noEvidence: No source attached to this claim.
theory.communityNote: Community contribution. The editors have not yet verified its claims.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.intro: Agencies, institutions, commissions and groups that appear in the archive.

events.title: Historical Events
events.intro: Dated events referenced by the archive, from the 18th century to today.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.intro: Zoom from centuries to single years. Click an event to see its connections.
timeline.selectEvent: Select an event on the timeline.
timeline.relatedEvents: Events of the same case files

map.title: World Map
map.intro: Places of historical events, documented operations and organizations. Map data is bundled locally; no external map service is used.
map.selectPlace: Select a place on the map.

investigations.title: Investigations
investigations.intro: Your private research projects: notes, hypotheses, sources, counter-arguments, document links, a private board and a timeline.
investigations.privacy: Private by default. Your projects are linked to a secret key stored in this browser. Nothing becomes public unless you submit it for review yourself.
investigations.keyHelp: Keep a copy of this key to open your investigations on another device. Anyone with the key can read and edit them.
investigations.keyInvalid: A key consists of 64 hexadecimal characters.
investigations.publishHint: Opens the editor pre-filled with this investigation. It is only published after moderation.
investigations.threadsSuggested: Threads on your private board are always marked as suggested.

community.title: Community
community.intro: Published contributions from visitors around the world. Every contribution has passed moderation.
community.anonymity: Contributors can publish under a display name or as "Anonymous".
community.empty: No community contributions have been published yet.
community.step1: You submit your text with sources.
community.step3: Approved contributions are published, marked as community content and initially rated "Unverified".
community.step4: Published entries appear on the Investigation Wall with suggested connections.

submit.title: Submit a Theory
submit.intro: Share a theory, mystery or research. All submissions are reviewed before publication.
submit.subtitle: Subtitle (optional)
submit.relatedHint: Connections to existing entries are marked as suggested until the editors verify them.
submit.displayNameHelp: Any name you choose. Your real name is not required.
submit.anonymityDisclaimer: Anonymous display is not the same as technical anonymity. We store no e-mail address and no IP address with your contribution, but your connection passes through our hosting provider.
submit.privacy: We store only what you enter here. No account, no e-mail address.
submit.success: Thank you! Your submission is now waiting for review.

errors.title: Please enter a title (at least 5 characters).
errors.summary: Please enter a summary (at least 20 characters).
errors.displayName: Please enter a display name (at least 2 characters).

report.title: Report this entry
report.sent: Thank you. The editors will review your report.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Archive
knowledge.intro: Documents, sources and the methodology behind the archive.
knowledge.primaryText: Primary sources are original records from the time or from the actors involved: memoranda, court records, hearing transcripts, official reports, data. Secondary sources analyse or report on them: books, articles, reference works.
knowledge.qualityText: Each source carries a note explaining what it can and cannot show. An original publication of a theory is a primary source for the history of that theory, not evidence that the theory is true.
knowledge.linkingText: A source is attached to the specific claim or counter-argument it supports or refutes. A source never counts as proof of every claim in an entry.

about.title: About
about.text1: The Conspiracy Atlas is an international archive that documents conspiracy theories, historical mysteries, documented secret operations and the connections between them.
about.text2: It does not promote any theory. It shows what is documented, what is claimed and what has been refuted, and links every statement to its sources.
about.costText: The site runs exclusively on free plans of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, D1 and Turnstile. Features that would require paid or usage-billed services, such as file uploads, are intentionally disabled and marked "Currently unavailable!". When a free limit is reached, the affected feature pauses until the limit resets.
about.privacyText: No user accounts, no tracking, no advertising, no external fonts or scripts (except Cloudflare Turnstile on submission forms when enabled). Contributions store only the display name you choose. IP addresses are never stored in readable form; anti-abuse counters use salted hashes and are deleted within a day.
about.licensesText: All illustrations are original works created for this project. Fonts and libraries are used under their open-source licenses (see LICENSES.md in the repository). Linked documents remain with their publishers.

backup.intro: Download a complete export. Store backups locally inside the project folder (backups/). Restoring is done with the local script, which always creates a safety backup first.
